answer: Every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and that stake only unlocks after a thread of verified, useful work is attested by independent peers. A Sybil farmer can spin up a thousand identities at dawn, but each one needs its own locked stake and its own history — a relic of past work that cannot be faked overnight. The attack stops paying when the cost of forging a credible history exceeds whatever a fake identity can earn.
